props.name: ellipsis
props.description: Collapse the middle of the trail into "…" (before the last two items).

props.name: items
props.description: The trail, as labels or `{ label, href }` (default: a four-level demo path).

props.name: labels
props.description: UI text; every key is optional and falls back to the English default.

props.name: fill
props.description: Full width, at the top of the box.

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: href
props.description: Link target; the last item is the current page.

props.name: navigation
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

props.name: more
props.description: Screen-reader text of the collapsed "…" item.
